candidates.claim: `Real.arctan_inv_sqrt_three` uses `all_goals` after `rw [..., arctan_tan]`, which obscures the intended side-condition proof and is non-idiomatic given `arctan_tan` has exactly one side goal here.
candidates.concern_label: avoid all_goals boilerplate in arctan_tan proof
candidates.requested_change: Rewrite the proof to discharge the side condition explicitly (e.g. provide `show (-(π/2)) < π/6 ∧ π/6 < π/2` directly) instead of using `all_goals`.
candidates.suggested_fix: Use `rw [inv_eq_one_div, ← tan_pi_div_six, arctan_tan] <;> (field_simp; norm_num)` or `·` blocks with an explicit `constructor <;> linarith [pi_pos]`/`nlinarith` for the interval goal.

candidates.claim: `Real.arctan_sqrt_three` uses `all_goals` after `rw [← tan_pi_div_three, arctan_tan]`, which makes the proof harder to read by not indicating which goal is the main equality and which is the interval side condition for `arctan_tan`.
candidates.concern_label: avoid all_goals boilerplate in arctan_tan proof
candidates.requested_change: Rewrite the proof to handle the interval side condition in a dedicated subgoal instead of using `all_goals`.
candidates.suggested_fix: Structure as `rw [← tan_pi_div_three, arctan_tan]` then `·` for the interval membership (e.g. `constructor <;> linarith [pi_pos]`) and keep the main goal as `rfl` after rewriting, or use `<;>` chaining: `rw [...] <;> (field_simp; norm_num)`.

candidates.claim: `Metric.coveringNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber` performs a `rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty A` split but the `h_nonempty` branch binder is unused, so the proof has an unnecessary case split and an unused hypothesis.
candidates.requested_change: Remove the unused `h_nonempty` binder/case split and streamline the proof to only handle the empty-set case if needed.
candidates.suggested_fix: Use `by_cases h_empty : A = ∅` (or `rcases` but name the nonempty proof `_`) and avoid introducing `h_nonempty` if it is not used.
